description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for setting and retrieving wireless network configurations on the xb6 platform. It includes session management, configuration parsing, interaction with device settings via getStr/setStr functions, and JSON responses for certain API calls.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS pin checksum according to length and checksum rules.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filtering parameters for MAC addresses and device names.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies configuration to a specific SSID by setting related device parameters.
